description:
- **Ultimate USB:** Add local Pro support for 12.5.0 build 1205000 (ARM64 APKS). Preserve operation confirmations and USB/filesystem drivers. Changed bytecode is rejected for review.

Enable pre-releases in the BadFella Patches source in Morphe Manager, refresh Sources, select the original Ultimate USB APKS and apply Ultimate USB local Pro. Install with your existing Manager signing key.

This changes local entitlement decisions and does not create a Google Play purchase. Startup integrity checks, Pro screen labels and USB operations on physical hardware remain unverified.
